title: Pende language
description: Bantu language spoken in the DR Congo
extract: Pende (Phende) is a Bantu language of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Giphende is spoken in Kwilu Province, in Gungu and Idiofa districts as well as some areas of Kasaï Province. The Bapende used to call themselves Akwa Nzumba, Akwa Thunda, or Akwa Mbongo.
